reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Public repository opened in Codex web; pinned README, implementation and LICENSE retrieved from public raw URLs and inspected. No upstream code executed.
identity_check: Exact repository owner/name checked; same-name projects and legacy aliases not merged by name.
role_findings_zh: Jev 根据新消息分类已有规则的变化，并判断自由文本禁令与待执行调用的关系；资源提取、规则状态更新及拦截由代码处理。
role_findings_en: Jev classifies changes to existing policies from new messages and judges free-text prohibitions against pending calls. Code extracts resources, updates policy state and enforces decisions.
limitations_zh: 作者提供了会话基准，本库未复跑。语义判断在低置信度或调用失败时可能放行，不是安全沙箱；无 Key 的规则模式不算 Jev 实测。
limitations_en: The session benchmarks are author-reported, not rerun here. Uncertain or failed semantic judgments can fail open; this is not a security sandbox. Keyless rules-only operation does not demonstrate Jev.

sources.inspected_scope: Project overview, Jev role, installation entry and limitations; full file captured, not every unrelated feature audited.
